Guidance & outlook: Welcome you all to the Pranik Logistics Limited Q1 FY 2026 earnings con call.
Another question I had was in terms of guidance, revenue guidance for the next quarters or like the next year.
And as we are targeting a revenue of INR500 crores by FY 2029.
Growth & demand: If we compare this, from June 24, we had growth of 75.52%.
If we compare with last year then it comes to growth of 77.6% in total.
So, there is a 40% in-the-revenue growth and definitely an exponentially margin growth that you will get.
Margins & costs: Over 95% plus on-time delivery rate, along with consistent and optimum fleet and warehouse utilization, makes us stand out and fragmented in this competitive market.
Total EBITDA this quarter was 3.65 and its margin was 9.32%.
Its PBT margin was INR 2.58 crores and tax expenses were INR 0.65 crores.
Capex & expansion: From operating into just a region and a few states, we now have pan-India presence, and our journey has been identified and defined by scalability, sustainability, and consistent margin expansions.
And these are giving us, coming into the operational efficiencies we are getting in, getting into the expansion, enjoying economies of scale.
Recently, there is a capex investment in next month or something from now that is being planned.
Balance sheet & cash: See, cash flows I will tell you, cash flows negative, there is another what had happens so that.
So that is the reason the cash flow might, if you would see even in the last year, cash, net cash would be showing negative.

Another follow-up question was there any guidance in terms of the kind of capital structure in terms of debt and how much debt we would raise if we want to grow our revenues and how does capex factor in and if you could just explain that in terms of your business, that would be helpful? ■ Pranik Logistics Limited August 08, 2025 Yes.
Risks & challenges: Cash has been negative for a while now, which you have mentioned as a risk earlier.
But over there the company will stand up with a risk of some sort of bad debt.
Where today, if I talk about at Pranik, we are at zero risk of bad debts.
